name: Serena Bloodfeather
summary: Across the northern Barrens, harpy raids threaten the Crossroads supply lines. Serena Bloodfeather leads the Witchwing flock, driven by a blood feud with the Horde after Rexxar slew her sister. Ending her campaign could break the harpies’ coordination.

sections.title: A Legacy of Vengeance
sections.body: Witchwing harpies strike the trails northwest of the Crossroads under Serena Bloodfeather’s command. Their attacks are driven by more than hunger: Serena seeks vengeance against the Horde. During Durotar’s founding, the beastmaster Rexxar slew her sister, the notorious matriarch Bloodfeather. Serena has rallied her flock to attack supply trains, scouts, and merchants traveling the arid trails.

sections.title: Cutting Off the Head
sections.body: Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads has led the effort to cull the harpies, from petty raiders to seasoned lieutenants. He now calls for Serena’s head as proof of her death and as a trophy for the next outgoing caravan. The Horde hopes that showing the surviving harpies their matriarch’s fate will frighten them away from the Barrens’ supply lines.

faq.q: Why is Serena Bloodfeather attacking Horde caravans?
faq.answer: Serena attacks Horde caravans to avenge her sister. The beastmaster Rexxar slew the harpy matriarch Bloodfeather during Durotar’s founding, and Serena now turns her flock against Horde supply wagons and travelers.

Bloodfeather was a notorious harpy leader who terrorized the borders of Durotar and the Barrens. Rexxar slew her while serving Warchief Thrall. Serena, her surviving sister, took up her mantle and grudge.

faq.q: Why does Darsok Swiftdagger want her head?
faq.answer: Darsok wants Serena’s head to confirm her death and display it on an outgoing caravan wagon. He hopes the sight will warn surviving harpies away from Horde supply lines.

faq.q: Where can Serena Bloodfeather be found?
faq.answer: Serena is among the rugged cliffs and wind-carved crags northwest of the Crossroads, surrounded by Witchwing lieutenants and guards.

faq.q: What happens after Serena is defeated?
faq.answer: After Serena falls, Darsok sends reliable mercenaries to help other allies in need. He dispatches them with a letter to Jin'Zil, the witch doctor in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc scout stationed at the Crossroads, assigns the bounty. He oversees efforts against wild threats along trade routes and issues it after the flock’s lower ranks have been cleared.

angles.text: The northern trade routes through the Crossroads supply orcish outposts and connect Durotar with Mulgore and Stonetalon. Putting down organized harpy raiders keeps those routes open.
As a rogue, you’ll find Darsok Swiftdagger values cold efficiency. He calls for Serena’s throat to be slit swiftly, without a prolonged fight.
As an orc, you face unfinished business tied to Rexxar’s deeds and the fierce struggles on Durotar’s early frontier.
